title: BACTrax procurement form data catalog
description: Shared data-binding contract for every imported procurement form. ProcurementFormSeeder checks each template binding against this schema before seeding.

displayFormats.currency: Formats numeric values as Philippine pesos.
displayFormats.number: Formats numeric values using the en-PH locale.

date.syntax: data-format="date:<pattern>"; date inputs default to dd-Mmm-yyyy when no pattern is provided.

true.durationNote: Count the seven days excluding Saturdays and Sundays.

rfq_delivery_schedule.behavior: The generic form renderer shows the matching input inside the target cell; selected values and conditional required validation remain bound to procurement fields.

procurement.rfq_number: Derived from pr_number by replacing the leading PR prefix with RFQ; never stored
procurement.rfq_documents: Selected rfq_documents ids joined through procurement_required_docs

items.source: Procurement::items ordered by line_no, including lot headers and child items
items.editable: Only item.cost (ABC per unit) on non-lot items; save updates procurement_items.cost and recalculates procurements.abc_amount

runtimePayload.form_defaults: The bound attachment's Form.configuration.template_data is merged into the runtime context.
runtimePayload.saved_values: Non-procurement attachment inputs are stored in existingAttachmentData[attachment_id].form_data. procurement.* and procurement.items.{id}.cost bindings persist to their Procurement and ProcurementItem records.

is_delivery_cd.label: Delivery duration is in calendar days

abc_amount.label: Approved Budget for the Contract
abc_amount.derived: sum(quantity * cost for non-lot procurement.items); synchronized by PR and attachment form save paths

item_bank_item_id.description: Optional link to the canonical Item Bank entry; never duplicates catalog data.

cost.description: Unit cost; lot header cost is derived from its sub-items.

procurement.rfq_number.derived: replace leading PR with RFQ in procurement.pr_number

item.cost.derivedUpdates: procurements.abc_amount = sum(quantity * cost) for non-lot items

rfq.required_documents[].scope: active rfq_documents catalog, ordered by sequence

notes: This is a reviewed form-facing allowlist, not a reflection of every column or Eloquent relation.
Template data is separate from template records. Values bind to procurement records or explicitly configured RFQ settings.
Never allow a template to mass-assign model fields directly; validate and map permitted paths in application code.
Relationship traversal is limited to five levels, stops on marked cycles, and should only serialize explicitly listed fields.
Database migrations are authoritative for column length, precision, scale, nullability, and defaults; update this snapshot when those change.

award.description: Form submission context for MIN, ABS, and RES. Editable award inputs and calculated bid data are persisted with the attachment submission until award persistence is introduced.

syncPolicy.behavior: All source forms use declared data-* bindings. The seeder rejects undeclared or drifted bindings, inline handlers, and executable Blade directives.

templateAttributeContract.data-input: Editable path. data-input-type selects the control; data-source identifies a JSON source for select controls.
templateAttributeContract.data-print: Read-only path rendered from the supplied context.
templateAttributeContract.data-each: Collection path. data-as names the row alias. data-renderer may select a collection-specific editor while preserving this binding.
templateAttributeContract.data-required: Required-field marker used by live validation and form compilation.
templateAttributeContract.data-format: Optional display format; supports currency, number, and date:<pattern>.
templateAttributeContract.data-default: Literal initial value for an empty editable binding.
templateAttributeContract.data-default-from: Path supplying an initial value when the binding is empty.
templateAttributeContract.data-input-type: Expected editor: text, textarea, number, date, email, or select.
templateAttributeContract.data-source: Named options list from the runtime context for a select editor.
templateAttributeContract.data-options: Inline, JSON-encoded select options when the list is template-defined.
templateAttributeContract.data-min: Minimum numeric value validated by the editor.
templateAttributeContract.data-label: Human-readable field name used in required-field feedback.
templateAttributeContract.data-pr-action: Allow-listed PR row editor action; valid values are recorded per template.
templateAttributeContract.data-pr-add-row: Allow-listed PR row kind; valid values are recorded per template.
templateAttributeContract.data-renderer: Selects an editor implementation for a collection while keeping its data-each binding authoritative.
